mechanisticRole: M2-PKV remains a separate scenario/mechanism model; no claim of incremental forecast accuracy.
selectionReason: Three predetermined neighboring Ostergotland municipalities spanning smaller and larger administrations; no selection on financial outcomes.
rules: Use precisely the frozen accounting_projection implementation; no new coefficients, bias correction, growth tuning or candidate search after results.
Retain all named municipalities, origins and horizons. Missing data must be recorded explicitly and not silently exclude a poor result.
Primary comparisons are previous result unchanged and unweighted historical mean using observations from 2020 through origin only.
Score each municipality in mnkr and absolute error divided by origin tax+grants, expressed in percentage points. The latter is the primary cross-municipality metric.
Report equal-municipality averages, by-target-year differences and leave-one-target-year-out descriptive ranges. Shared macro years are not independent shocks.
Use gross personnel including pensions exactly once; other operating expense is gross operating expense less total personnel. Preserve rounding/reclassifications and disclose source revisions.
No calibration to public budgets or target-year data. External PKV forecasts remain the frozen original December vintages.
This is a separately acquired retrospective external-municipality check, not historical real-time validation and not independent macro-regime evidence.
All h1/h2/h3 results must remain visible. A positive one-year result must not be advertised as validated three-year accuracy.
